guide.summary: Harbourfront sights, Speicherstadt museums, art collections, restaurants, bakeries, coffee roasters and cocktail bars in Hamburg, each checked against its own website.
guide.tip: Buy Miniatur Wunderland tickets online in advance, as its own site advises, and pre-book an Elbphilharmonie Plaza slot if you want guaranteed entry at a set time (€5 booking fee).

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: BallinStadt opens Tuesday to Sunday only, and Restaurant Haerlin serves dinner Tuesday to Saturday. The Fischauktionshalle market runs on Sundays from 06:00 to 12:00.

toolkit.label: Tickets and booking
toolkit.copy: Miniatur Wunderland advises buying tickets online in advance to avoid long waits. Elbphilharmonie Plaza pre-booking costs €5 per ticket and guarantees your chosen entry time.

toolkit.label: Walk-in policies
toolkit.copy: The Bullerei Deli takes no reservations, while its restaurant takes bookings 60 days ahead. Groups of five or more at Restaurant Haerlin must book by email.

toolkit.label: Rules
toolkit.copy: At the Elbphilharmonie, bags A3 size or larger, luggage and walking-stick umbrellas go in ground-floor lockers. Restaurant Haerlin asks for smart casual dress.

guide.dek: Group the harbour and Speicherstadt sights into one day, and book Miniatur Wunderland and an Elbphilharmonie Plaza slot before you go.
intro: Start at the Elbphilharmonie Plaza, the public viewing level on the 8th floor, open daily from 10:00 to 24:00 with last admission at 23:30. Capacity is controlled with Plaza tickets, and if you pre-book online or on site you pay a €5 booking fee per ticket, which guarantees entry at your chosen time. A concert ticket also gets you onto the Plaza from two hours before the performance. From there it is a short walk into the Speicherstadt, where the Speicherstadtmuseum on Am Sandtorkai has extended its exhibition on the pre-war warehouse district until 10 January 2027.

Miniatur Wunderland, at Kehrwieder 2 in the Speicherstadt, opens every day, always at least from 09:30 to 18:00, and often later at weekends, on Tuesdays and in school holidays. Its own admission page advises buying tickets online in advance to avoid long waits; adults pay 22.00 € and children under 1 m go free. Nearby, the Internationales Maritimes Museum in Kaispeicher B opens daily from 10:00 to 18:00, with "Heroes of the Sea" running until 31 December 2026 and a cheaper Störtebeker Ticket from 16:30.

For art, the Bucerius Kunst Forum on Alter Wall opens daily from 11:00 to 19:00 and until 21:00 on Thursdays, and its exhibition "Von Monet bis Picasso" runs until 29 March 2027. The Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe on Steintorplatz shows "Hella Jongerius: Whispering Things" until 13 June 2027. The Hamburger Kunsthalle offers free entry from 6 to 9 pm on the first Thursday of the month. At Hauptkirche St. Michaelis the tower is open from 09:00 to 19:00, and the church hosts its Bach-Wochen until 22 November.

Plan meals around the clock. Café Paris on Rathausstraße serves breakfast from 9.00 (9.30 on Sundays), and Café Condi at Hotel Vier Jahreszeiten runs its breakfast buffet until 11:00 on weekdays. At the Bullerei near Sternschanze the Deli takes no reservations, while restaurant tables open for booking 60 days ahead. Restaurant Haerlin opens Tuesday to Saturday with a smart casual dress code. For a drink with a harbour view, the Tower Bar at Hotel Hafen Hamburg opens from 18:00.
summaryCards: Pair the Elbphilharmonie Plaza (daily 10:00–24:00) with Miniatur Wunderland and the Speicherstadtmuseum, all in or beside the Speicherstadt.
Take the Café Condi breakfast buffet or breakfast at Café Paris, then coffee at Speicherstadt Kaffeerösterei, open daily 10.00–18.00.
Bullerei restaurant tables open 60 days ahead, and Miniatur Wunderland recommends buying tickets online in advance.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability. Le Lion and Elbgold returned HTTP 429 on every attempt; Rindermarkthalle St. Pauli, Brücke 10 and Bäckerei Junge failed with TLS errors; Boilerman Bar had a certificate mismatch; Dat Backhus and Museum der Arbeit refused connections; Public Coffee Roasters, Daniel Wischer and The Chug Club domains did not resolve. Mutterland, Planten un Blomen, Deichtorhallen, Dialog im Dunkeln and the Hamburg Dungeon published no street address on the pages read. Weekly hours were not readable for Hamburger Kunsthalle, Museum für Kunst und Gewerbe, Tierpark Hagenbeck, Fischereihafen Restaurant, clouds, Skyline Bar 20up, Rickmer Rickmers, Cap San Diego, Chocoversum (museum), Alster-Touristik and the HADAG ferries (timetables via HVV). Old Commercial Room, Zeit für Brot, Nord Coast, Fischauktionshalle, HADAG and Cap San Diego showed no dated 2026 item beyond hours, bookings or copyright lines, so they are marked medium confidence.
